Subject: New payment entity and remit instructions for Avalon Supply Co.

Hi Marissa and team,

Quick note from Avalon — we've completed a legal restructure of our US operations and need Redwood to start sending invoices to a new payment entity effective immediately. The new remit/pay-to name is "Avalon Supply US, LLC" (previously Avalon Supply Inc.).

Key requests:
- Update vendor record to reflect new legal entity name and remit address (see attached ChangeOfEntity_Notice.pdf).
- Route future wire/ACH payments to the bank listed in BankLetter_Avalon_2026.pdf.
- Please confirm whether a new W-9 is required on your side; we've attached an updated W9.

New preferred remit address: 1203 Meridian Parkway, Suite 400, Raleigh, NC 27615
New AP email for invoices: accounts@avalonsupply.co

I've CC'd our AP lead Oliver for any follow-ups. We need confirmation from Redwood by EOW so our finance team can match upcoming invoices.

Thanks,

Lydia Park
Finance Ops Manager
Avalon Supply Co.
lydia.park@avalonsupply.co
(919) 555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New payment entity and remit instructions for Avalon Supply Co.

Hi Lydia — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Quick checklist from our side so we can process this cleanly: 

1) We need the signed Change of Entity doc (your attachment looks good) and the updated W-9 (you included one; thanks).
2) For bank routing changes we require a bank letter plus one of the following: a previously paid remit transaction or a voided check. BankLetter_Avalon_2026.pdf should be fine but Finance may ask for the voided check for ACH verification.
3) Please confirm the effective date you want Redwood to start paying to Avalon Supply US, LLC.
4) I'll initiate a vendor record update ticket with AP and include a short verification call if needed.

Operational note: to avoid payment hold we typically require 7 business days to update vendor records and PO routing; if you need faster processing let us know and we can request an expedited review (may require AP manager approval).

Can you confirm the effective date and whether you'll send a voided check? Once you confirm I'll loop in AP and share the vendor change ticket ID.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Procurement
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

- Legal name changed to: Avalon Supply US, LLC
